## Comparability note

Alaska Air Group's FY2024 results are **not** directly comparable to FY2022/FY2023 on an as-reported basis: Alaska closed its acquisition of Hawaiian Holdings on September 18, 2024, and Hawaiian's results are consolidated only from that date forward [DOC-2]. Per the 10-K, Hawaiian contributed **$869 million of revenue** from the acquisition date to December 31, 2024 [DOC-2]. I therefore use an adjusted Alaska FY2024 revenue of $11,735M − $869M = **$10,866M** [DOC-1][DOC-2]. Note this is only a stub-period adjustment (Sept 18–Dec 31); it does not restate prior years for Hawaiian, and any acquisition-related effects on legacy Alaska operations remain embedded. The other four carriers are clean calendar-year, like-for-like comparisons [DOC-1].

## Ranking 1 — FY2023 → FY2024 revenue growth

| Rank | Airline | FY2023 | FY2024 | Growth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | United | $53,717M | $57,063M | **+6.23%** [DOC-1] |
| 2 | Delta | $58,048M | $61,643M | **+6.19%** [DOC-1] |
| 3 | Southwest | $26,091M | $27,483M | **+5.34%** [DOC-1] |
| 4 | Alaska (ex‑Hawaiian) | $10,426M | $10,866M | **+4.22%** [DOC-1][DOC-2] |
| 5 | American | $52,788M | $54,211M | **+2.70%** [DOC-1] |

United and Delta are separated by only ~4 basis points — effectively a tie.
(Alaska as reported would be +12.55%, but that growth is almost entirely acquisition-driven [DOC-2].)

## Ranking 2 — FY2022 → FY2024 revenue growth

| Rank | Airline | FY2022 | FY2024 | Growth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | United | $44,955M | $57,063M | **+26.93%** [DOC-1] |
| 2 | Delta | $50,582M | $61,643M | **+21.87%** [DOC-1] |
| 3 | Southwest | $23,814M | $27,483M | **+15.41%** [DOC-1] |
| 4 | Alaska (ex‑Hawaiian) | $9,646M | $10,866M | **+12.65%** [DOC-1][DOC-2] |
| 5 | American | $48,971M | $54,211M | **+10.70%** [DOC-1] |

## Conclusion

Yes — **United Airlines Holdings ranks first in both rankings**, though its FY2023→FY2024 lead over Delta is within rounding significance (6.23% vs. 6.19%), while its two-year lead (26.93% vs. 21.87%) is decisive. The full ordering is identical across both periods: United, Delta, Southwest, Alaska (ex‑Hawaiian), American.

ANSWER: Yes — United is top-ranked in both. FY23→FY24 (Alaska ex‑Hawaiian): United +6.23%, Delta +6.19%, Southwest +5.34%, Alaska +4.22%, American +2.70%. FY22→FY24: United +26.93%, Delta +21.87%, Southwest +15.41%, Alaska +12.65%, American +10.70%.
